outcome: Protein abundance of CB1 cannabinoid receptor
mRNA expression of CB1 cannabinoid receptor
cohort: Uterine and placental tissue samples were collected from 20 women (9 laboring, 11 nonlaboring) undergoing cesarean delivery.
finding: The protein abundance of the CB1 cannabinoid receptor in uterine tissue was significantly lower in tissues exposed to labor compared with tissues not exposed to labor.
cross-section timing: At the time of cesarean delivery
